display_long_description:
Welcome to Monkilla!
Get ready for a wild adventure inspired by the hit game Gorilla Tag! In Monkilla, movement is everything — swing, jump, climb and zipline using just your hands and controllers. No need for walking locomotion just your controllers!

🌲 Explore Diverse Maps
Traverse the vast and exciting environments!

Forest: Hang around the gazebo and make some friends while having a blast at tag!

City: Explore our various displays of cosmetic. it may not be much but we are expanding this bute as is! 

Caves: Venture into the depths of the caves and mines to figure out the secrets of project REVOC...

Canyon: Leap across floor to floor with many ziplines about to help you move!

🎮 Movement 
Use your hands to propel yourself forward, climb trees, scale walls, and swing about!. Every motion is powered by your own physical effort. like your pulling yourself along with your character!

👬 Play in a privte or with friends
Join a public lobby or invite your friends to a private session. Play some tag! or hang out and use our in built menus for even more fun! — it’s up to you! Try different game modes like tag, casual and our modded experience, just explore at your own pace.

✨ What Are You Waiting For?
Adventure awaits in Monkilla! Whether you're Tagging other monkeys, uncovering secrets of the cave and REVOC, or running wild in the city, there’s always something new to discover in monkilla!
